features.text: Validate: Validates a HTML document for web accessibility compliance. (POST /v4.0/html/accessibility)
Convert: Converts a file from one format to another asynchronously. (POST /v4.0/html/conversion/{from}-{to})
GetConversionStatus: Get the asynchronous conversion operation status by its ID (GET /v4.0/html/conversion/{id})
delete/v4.0/html/conversion/{id}: Force termination of the asynchronous conversion operation by its ID (DELETE /v4.0/html/conversion/{id})
DownloadFile: Download the result of a completed conversion operation (GET /v4.0/html/conversion/{id}/download)
ConvertSync: Converts a file from one format to another synchronously. (POST /v4.0/html/conversion/{from}-{to}/sync)
Vectorize: Vectorize an image file to SVG. (POST /v4.0/html/vectorization/{from})
GetVectorizationStatus: Get the asynchronous vectorization operation status by its ID (GET /v4.0/html/vectorization/{id})
delete/v4.0/html/vectorization/{id}: Force termination of the asynchronous vectorization operation by its ID (DELETE /v4.0/html/vectorization/{id})
VectorizeSync: Vectorize an image file to SVG synchronously. (POST /v4.0/html/vectorization/{from}/sync)
